name: calendar-card
title: Calendar
description: A month card where the selected day glides from date to date.
docs:
Calendar — A month card where the selected day glides from date to date.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep the two together in components/pinui/.

It is drawn in Inter (400 to 600). If your project does not already load that face it will fall back to your system sans and look noticeably different.

It comes in two themes: pass theme="dark" for the dark one, or wire the prop to your own theme switch.
